# teltonika_rms_task_group (Data Source)

Looks up a single task group by id (`GET /devices/tasks/groups/{id}`) and its tasks (`GET /devices/tasks?group_id={id}`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "teltonika_rms_task_group" "zero_touch" {
  id = "41"
}

output "task_names" {
  value = [for t in data.teltonika_rms_task_group.zero_touch.tasks : t.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) RMS task group id.

### Read-Only

- `company_id` (Number)
- `created_at` (String)
- `failed_tag_ids` (List of Number)
- `name` (String)
- `success_tag_ids` (List of Number)
- `tasks` (List of Object) Tasks belonging to the group, in execution order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tasks))
- `updated_at` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--tasks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tasks`

Read-Only:

- `data` (Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedobjatt--tasks--data))
- `id` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `order` (Number)
- `stop_on_failure` (Boolean)
- `timeout` (Number)
- `type` (String)
